_notes: Ground-truth labeled examples for eval regression testing. Each example is a Slack message (or conversation block) with the correct Jira classification. Source: 'manual' = human-curated, 'validated' = team 👍 confirmed in production.

labels.slack_text: App crashes when uploading any file larger than 10MB. Tried three times, reproducible every time. We're losing customer uploads.
labels.notes: Reproducible crash with direct customer impact. 'We're losing customer uploads' is the impact signal.

labels.slack_text: Login is completely broken — getting a 500 error on every login attempt. Nobody can sign in.
labels.notes: Total feature failure with broad user impact.

labels.slack_text: Payment processing is failing for all Visa cards. Stripe is returning a 402. Our checkout is down.
labels.notes: Revenue-impacting, production-down. High even though the root cause is a third-party API.

labels.slack_text:
Alice: the /api/users endpoint is returning 404
Bob: yeah same, started about an hour ago
Charlie: all GET requests to that endpoint are failing, not just one user
labels.notes: Multi-person block confirming the same issue. Three reporters + 'all GET requests' = High. One ticket for the block, not one per person.

labels.slack_text: The CSV export is missing the last row of data. Just noticed it when auditing a report.
labels.notes: Data integrity bug but not blocking. User can still export, just incomplete.

labels.slack_text: Profile picture doesn't update immediately after uploading. You have to do a full page refresh to see the new one.
labels.notes: UI inconsistency on a core feature. Not Low because it's profile — a frequently used flow.

labels.slack_text: Search results are showing deleted items. Tested with three different deleted entries — all showing up.
labels.notes: Data correctness issue. Showing deleted data is a trust problem. Medium.

labels.slack_text: Email notifications from the app are going to spam for a few of our users. Not all of them, but three people mentioned it this week.
labels.notes: Affects a subset of users, deliverability issue. Medium not High because it's partial and not blocking core function.

labels.slack_text: There's a typo on the settings page — 'Prefernces' should be 'Preferences'.
labels.notes: Cosmetic defect. Bug (it's wrong) not Task — the word is there, just misspelled.

labels.slack_text: The sidebar menu flickers briefly when you first load the dashboard in Chrome. Doesn't affect functionality.
labels.notes: Visual glitch, no functional impact, browser-specific. Bug not Task — something is rendering incorrectly.

labels.slack_text: It would be really helpful to have a bulk export option for all reports at once instead of exporting them one by one.
labels.notes: New capability. 'Would be really helpful' and 'instead of' = feature request not defect.

labels.slack_text: We need to add two-factor authentication before the enterprise launch next month. This is a blocker for the deal.
labels.notes: TRICKY: sounds like a task but 2FA doesn't exist yet — it's a new capability. High because of explicit business-impact signal ('blocker for the deal'). Story:High not Task:High.

labels.slack_text: Can we support assigning a ticket to multiple people? Right now it's only one assignee.
labels.notes: TRICKY: new behaviour on an existing feature. Story, not Bug — single assignee is the current intended behaviour, not a defect.

labels.slack_text: Would be nice to have dark mode in the mobile app at some point.
labels.notes: 'At some point' and 'would be nice' both signal Low. This is a wish, not a need.

labels.slack_text: We need to upgrade our React version to 18.x before next quarter. Current version has known security vulnerabilities.
labels.notes: Technical work item. Security angle raises from Low to Medium but it's not a breach and not breaking = Medium not High.

labels.slack_text: We should add structured logging to the payment service. Right now debugging production issues means reading through unstructured stdout.
labels.notes: Operational improvement. No new user-facing feature, no broken behaviour. Task:Medium.

labels.slack_text: We need to set up a staging environment for the new payments microservice.
labels.notes: Infrastructure setup. No new user-facing capability, no defect. Task not Story — the output is an environment, not a feature.

labels.slack_text: The README hasn't been updated to reflect the new deployment process. New engineers are following outdated instructions.
labels.notes: Documentation update. No code change, no user-facing impact.

labels.slack_text: We need to rotate the AWS API keys immediately — they were accidentally committed to the public GitHub repo this morning.
labels.notes: TRICKY: security incident. Task (rotate keys — no new feature, no bug in the product) but High — time-sensitive, active exposure. Agent often misclassifies as Bug.

labels.slack_text: The app should warn me before I permanently delete a project. I just deleted the wrong one and there's no way to recover it.
labels.notes: TRICKY: phrased as a feature request ('should warn me') but the missing confirmation guard caused unrecoverable data loss. That makes it a Bug:High, not a Story.

labels.slack_text: The API docs are completely wrong for the /orders endpoint — they show the old request format we changed 3 months ago.
labels.notes: TRICKY: 'completely wrong' sounds like Bug but the API itself is correct — the docs are a separate artefact that is outdated. Task:Medium.

labels.slack_text:
Alice: getting a white screen on the reports page
Bob: same here, just happened to me
Alice: seems like it started after this morning's deploy
labels.notes: TRICKY: multi-reporter block. Two confirmations + deploy correlation = likely regression. Bug:High. One ticket for the whole block.

labels.slack_text: The onboarding email has a broken link to the docs site.
labels.notes: TRICKY on priority: broken link in a transactional email that goes to every new user = broader impact than a broken link on an internal page. Medium not Low.

labels.slack_text: Something's wrong with the dashboard.
labels.notes: Not enough to classify. Ask: what specifically is wrong, which part, when did it start, any error message?

labels.slack_text: The app feels slow lately.
labels.notes: Vague performance complaint. No specific page, no reproduction steps, no baseline. Ask: which part, how slow, started when?

labels.slack_text: Users are complaining about the checkout.
labels.notes: Second-hand report with no detail. 'Complaining' about what? Error? Slow? Confusing UI? Ask before creating a ticket.
